claim_policy.reason: Only three complete blocks were retained. The result is a technical sanity record, not evidence for a performance ranking.

bracket_pair_guides.measurement_scope_note: The measured candidate predates the native matched-brace setting persistence fix for IDE shutdown and dynamic unload, plus later descriptor-description-only documentation updates. The pairing, caret-command, rendering, and indexing paths exercised by this workload are unchanged.

activation_evidence.configuration_equivalence: Each plugin used its out-of-box settings. The screenshots confirmed output activation, not feature-equivalent configuration across products.

bracket_pair_guides.observed_output: Bracket-token colors and one caret-containing active pair guide were visible.

rainbow_brackets.observed_output: Default bracket colorization was visible and no large-file disable banner appeared.

color_brackets.observed_output: Default bracket colors and its caret-related vertical indicator were visible.

per_row: fresh clone of one common prewarmed config and system template
open the fixed fixture and wait 45 seconds
move to a fixed offset, fence the EDT, and wait 5 seconds
perform JBR full GC and sample MemoryMXBean heap used bytes
sample whole-process CPU time over a 30-second idle window
perform 200 warmup and 1000 measured near-viewport synchronous caret commands
perform 200 warmup and 1000 measured far/scrolling synchronous caret commands
exit and validate plugin load, native highlighting, metrics, and artifact hashes

metrics.heap: instantaneous whole-IDE JVM used heap after observed full GC; not plugin-retained heap or RSS
metrics.idle_cpu: whole-IDE process CPU time during the actual approximately 30-second wall interval
metrics.near_ms: JetBrains performanceTesting Timer for 1000 near-viewport synchronous %goto commands; no deferred visual-update fence
metrics.far_ms: JetBrains performanceTesting Timer for 1000 far synchronous %goto commands that may scroll/recenter; no deferred visual-update fence

protocol.failure_policy: Preserve every row. If one row fails, exclude that attempt and rerun all four variants with a new attempt identifier.

amendments.change: Reduced the predeclared run from ten blocks to three complete blocks.
amendments.effect: Exploratory median and range only; no CI threshold or promotional claim.

amendments.incident: A Korean IME input inserted U+3134 into the shared fixture after block 3 slot 2.
amendments.detection: The fixture changed from 139956 to 139959 bytes and failed the frozen SHA-256 preflight with exit 21.
amendments.disposition: Two valid partial rows and ten preflight-failed rows remain in raw-runs.csv/audit.csv but are excluded. The canonical fixture was regenerated, made read-only, and block 3 was rerun in full as 3r.

known_log_issue.observation: Every selected Color run completed all metrics, then shutdown logged a plugin-attributed undisposed Sources.EditorCtrl child and a Timer-3 NullPointerException after ApplicationManager returned null.
known_log_issue.treatment: Rows remain metric-valid and are explicitly marked log_clean=false.
